SEARCH
Package persist.hibernate.enhance.spi

Interface HibernateEnhancerProvider

All Superinterfaces:
PersistenceServiceProvider
All Known Implementing Classes:
JakartaHibernateEnhancerProvider, LegacyHibernateEnhancerProvider
public interface HibernateEnhancerProvider extends PersistenceServiceProvider
Service-provider interface for obtaining a namespace-specific HibernateEnhancer.

Implementations are discovered at runtime via ServiceLoader. The convenience method getHibernateEnhancerProvider(String) maps a JPA specification version to the correct provider.

Since:
1.0.0

  • Method Details

    • getEnhancer

      HibernateEnhancer getEnhancer(File classesDir, Set<File> classpathFiles, Map<HibernateEnhancer.Option,Boolean> options)
      Creates a HibernateEnhancer configured with the given classpath and enhancement options.
      Parameters:
      classesDir - the directory containing compiled entity class files
      classpathFiles - additional classpath entries required for enhancement (e.g. JPA API and Hibernate JARs)
      options - a map of HibernateEnhancer.Option flags controlling which transformations are applied
      Returns:
      a new enhancer instance

    • getHibernateEnhancerProvider

      static HibernateEnhancerProvider getHibernateEnhancerProvider(String jpaVersion)
      Discovers and returns the HibernateEnhancerProvider for the given JPA specification version.
      Parameters:
      jpaVersion - the JPA specification version (e.g. "3.1")
      Returns:
      the matching provider
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if jpaVersion is not recognised
      IllegalStateException - if no provider is registered for the resolved namespace
